projects.name: Green Public Transit Expansion
projects.description: Invest in electrified buses, new bike lanes, and charging infrastructure to reduce emissions and traffic congestion.

projects.name: AI Innovation District
projects.description: Create a technology district offering tax incentives and infrastructure support to attract AI companies and startups.

projects.name: Universal Childcare Program
projects.description: Provide publicly funded childcare services for all residents with children under five.

projects.name: International Smart City Expo
projects.description: Host an international innovation and technology summit to improve the city's visibility and attract tourism.

projects.name: Affordable Housing Initiative
projects.description: Build 3,000 affordable housing units for low-income residents.

projects.name: Green Industrial Corridor
projects.description: Develop a manufacturing zone dedicated to green technologies, projected to create thousands of jobs.

projects.name: Neighborhood Surveillance Program
projects.description: Deploy AI-assisted cameras around schools and residential neighborhoods to improve safety.

projects.name: Cultural Heritage Landmark
projects.description: Construct a landmark cultural center intended to become a symbol of the city.

projects.name: Community Employment Guarantee
projects.description: Provide guaranteed employment opportunities for unemployed residents through public works programs.

projects.name: Urban Congestion Tax
projects.description: Introduce congestion pricing for vehicles entering the city center and use revenues to fund sustainability initiatives.

projects.name: Urban Parks & Safe School Routes
projects.description: Develop a network of neighborhood parks, urban green spaces, tree planting initiatives, and protected walking and cycling routes connecting residential neighborhoods to schools.

projects.name: Community Health & Green Clinics
projects.description: Establish energy-efficient community health centers with green spaces, preventive healthcare programs, and accessible family services, particularly in underserved neighborhoods.

projects.name: Circular Economy Business Hub
projects.description: Develop a business and innovation hub supporting startups and manufacturers focused on recycling, repair, and sustainable production to promote green entrepreneurship and local employment.
